articles.summary: With Mastercard Accept issuers can extend everyday acceptance capabilities to debit and prepaid cardholders through existing banking channels and experiences. While making digital payments has become second nature, getting paid and receiving them can still be complex. Whether you're a street food vendor in Asia, selling homemade crafts at a market in Latin America, earning extra income for tutoring in Africa, or selling a second-hand bicycle through an online marketplace in the Middle East. Whether collecting payment for goods and services or turning a personal skill into a side hustle: How do you get paid? Worldwide, this question matters to the people who earn income through informal work and independent services, many of whom still rely on cash. Sharing personal details or navigating unfamiliar payment services and platforms to get paid can be daunting. As our lives evolve, and people move between shopping, selling, earning and sending money daily, the way we get paid must evolve
articles.title: Mastercard Enables Debit Cardholders to Get Paid as Easily as They Pay
